ABOUT US

Practical people.
Shared purpose.

A Phalaborwa-based company bringing industrial, construction and agricultural expertise to the work that moves businesses and communities forward.

CLEMENT PROJECTS SOLUTION

OUR COMPANY

A clear understanding.
A practical solution.

Clement Projects Solution (Pty) Ltd specialises in the supply, manufacture and repair of pumping equipment, civil and building construction, mechanical services and agricultural support.

Our base in Mashishimale, Phalaborwa connects us with the industries, infrastructure and farms that shape our region. Across each area, we value clear communication, professional service and long-term working relationships.

Our ambition is to be a preferred manufacturing and construction partner, recognised for quality, innovation and customer satisfaction.

OUR LEADERSHIP

Led with purpose.

Shai Clement

FOUNDER & MANAGING DIRECTOR

Shai Clement leads CPS with a background in construction and mechanical engineering. His qualifications include a National Certificate in Construction Contracting, Level 2, and Engineering Related Design (Fitting & Turning), Level 3.

His background also includes Leadership & Governance and Business Management.

His focus is on bringing practical expertise, a commitment to service and a clear understanding of client requirements to the company’s work.
